When they reached the top, however, they froze, saw the guards that awaited them, and then slowly drifted back down to the ground. The message was clear to me: there is no escape from the Maw.

I’ve pieced together that during the Wurmkin’s rise to power, many Echoes were left unaccounted for, sealed away by the Kinhost in forgotten tunnels. Many that have been found have gone dark, their knowledge lost forever, but occasionally some are found that have fed off the passing souls above. It seems even this latent charge has been enough to preserve them.

In fact, the Punished were eager to submit themselves to the trials no matter how painful they were. For, to them, to give themselves to pain was to show that they were true believers.

Hell and Heaven aren’t that different, each one having its faults, but also having its wonderful beauties. I am not proud of what I did, nor what came after. The only solace is that, at the time, I believed it to be right, and without that conviction we are all lost. Though, I doubt Seraph will see it the same way.

My daughter and I combined our expertise—she in the structural, I in the mechanical—and designed a train room that could fabricate new stewards as we needed.”—Herzal, “My Workshop, My Life”

—from Dr. Orechi’s notebooks

—OHELL Safety Regulations and Guidelines

Fade says she split the rock because she was bored, but her subsequent silence seems to suggest a more altruistic purpose. Why are they showing me these things?

“My experiments tend to take a toll on my the bodies of my assistants. I made this contraption so I could collect new parts with more efficiency.”
—from Dr. Orechi’s notebook

I wouldn’t go so far as to say I’m fluent, but this odd influx of knowledge has been remarkable and likely the result of the Wurmkin’s Echoes injecting me with it on their own will. Will they take it away just as easily?

The Rail had been built without the Ring’s consent, the life found above ground appearing to show no sentience. So, when I found a clan, a civilization even, that existed within the excavated remains of the Bogwurm, I realized that there are more holes to my knowledge than I previously assumed.
